name: Nami
source: “The proud and hot-blooded leader of the three ninjas, Nami is an expert with shuriken. She’s extremely confident in her skills, and can’t stand losing. While Nami resents you for outwitting her at times, she eventually begins to appreciate your steadfast nature and desire to approach things peacefully. Although, she’d rather die than admit it...”
